- `other-ns` has **no NetworkPolicy**, so no policy enforces a block on `blocked-client`. Since Calico has no default deny, the client could reach the pod regardless of the namespace.

Only one policy existed in the namespace; cross-namespace access was missing on the denial side, but there was no existing allow policy in `other-ns` to whitelist `client-ns` traffic.

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-all-ingress
  namespace: other-ns
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          strict-namespace: "other-ns"
```
